responsibility: This file implements the language-level M2EXCEPTION helpers that sit on top of the runtime exception block machinery. It defines the Modula-2 exception enumeration, queries the current RTExceptions block to return the active exception code, reports whether execution is presently exceptional, and initializes a base exception block for the runtime, making it the language-facing adapter rather than the general handler stack implementation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the language-facing exception queries declared in GM2EXCEPTION.h by interrogating RTExceptions state and initializing the runtime exception block; the header mainly publishes the enum and query signatures.
